parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance from which users are to be removed.

parameters.name: SkillGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the skill group from which users are to be removed.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description:
The IDs of the users to be removed from the skill group.

**UserId.1** indicates that only one agent is removed. To remove multiple agents, specify multiple values, such as UserId.1, UserId.2, and UserId.3. Note that this is the unique identifier of the RAM user within the Cloud Call Center instance, not the RamId. It is a UUID.
